author: /root/inventory_repair
boundary: Existing platform/auth::JwtIssuer/JwtVerifier ES256 material; plain verified cryptographic Account/CSRF claims only. No AccountSession/Principal construction or DB reads/permissions.
placement: Private nested account module under jwt.rs can access existing keys/settings; root-export only these input/output names through existing lib.rs. Do not duplicate issuer/verifier types or add dependencies.

types.AccountAssurance: enum { PasskeyPrimary }; wire PASSKEY_PRIMARY. Typed protocol metadata supplied only after actual upstream primary proof; type construction is not evidence of that proof.
types.AccountAccessTokenInput: public account_id:Uuid, session_id:Uuid, security_generation:i64, auth_time:OffsetDateTime, assurance:AccountAssurance, issued_at:OffsetDateTime, family_expires_at:OffsetDateTime
types.AccountCsrfTokenInput: public account_id:Uuid, session_id:Uuid, security_generation:i64, issued_at:OffsetDateTime, family_expires_at:OffsetDateTime
types.SignedAccountToken: private token bytes, explicit as_str()->&str, redacted Debug; no token bytes in Debug/errors and no implicit Serialize/Display. One opaque wrapper can carry either signed protocol; verifier methods remain distinct.
types.AccountAccessClaims: closed required iss:String,aud:String,token_kind:String,sub:Uuid,sid:Uuid,jti:Uuid,iat:i64,nbf:i64,exp:i64,security_generation:i64,auth_time:i64,assurance:AccountAssurance. security_generation wire canonical positive decimal string through i64::MAX. UUID wire canonical lowercase nonnil.; redacted Debug with no claim values. It may implement Serialize only if the owning API needs it; acceptance reads actual signed wire independently.
types.AccountCsrfClaims: closed required iss:String,aud:String,token_kind:String,sub:Uuid,sid:Uuid,iat:i64,nbf:i64,exp:i64,security_generation:i64; same generation and UUID representations; no jti/auth_time/assurance/Company claims.; redacted Debug with no claim values.
types.AccountAccessVerification: enum { Current(AccountAccessClaims), Expired(AccountAccessClaims) }; both plain validated cryptographic claims, never AccountSession/Principal. Redacted Debug. Expired is available only after all non-expiry checks pass.

rules: Existing configured issuer and ES256 keys; fixed access aud console.account.v1/kind account_v1 and proof aud console.account.csrf.v1/kind account_csrf_v1. Legacy settings audience does not override either protocol. Configured issuer must be nonempty; empty issuer fails with a fixed safe configuration error before any new protocol can be used.

Access lifetime=min(positive configured access TTL,15minutes,remaining absolute family lifetime); proof lifetime=min(5minutes,remaining absolute family lifetime). Expiry arithmetic checked before overflowing OffsetDateTime. Nonpositive or unrepresentable duration/ceiling must fail closed; never wrap or produce a usable unbounded token.

Verification now is exclusively the trusted server clock, never HTTP input. All signed iat/nbf/exp are nonnegative integers; primary auth_time is nonnegative and <=iat. Positive lifetime: exp>iat and nbf<=exp; signed span exp-iat<=900 access or300 proof seconds using checked arithmetic. All signature/ES256/issuer/fixed audience-kind/closed grammar/UUID/generation and non-expiry time checks, including no future iat/nbf, pass first. Then access exp>now =>Current, exp<=now=>Expired with the verified claims retained. Proof exp<=now=>fixed unit ExpiredSignature. No library60second grace, plain unverified decode, or expired-token acceptance that skips other checks. Issuance sets nbf=iat, access jti freshly generated.

Required fields and raw duplicate claims rejected, including identical duplicates. Unknown Company/role/profile claims rejected; parser conversion must not collapse duplicates into a generic Value before typed rejection.

Semantic UUID nonnil/canonical lowercase and generation positive canonical decimal bounded by signed database bigint. Missing/negative/zero/float/array/null or numeric generation rejected. Parsed valid generation is not current generation authority.

Raw JWT/proof/key bytes and hostile claim values stay out of token/claims/outcome/error Debug and error Display. Reuse AuthError, but new verification methods return only AuthError::Jwt with fixed ErrorKind::InvalidToken for malformed/crypto/issuer/audience/kind/claim/non-expiry-time failures, and fixed ErrorKind::ExpiredSignature for otherwise valid expired proof. Do not propagate serde/jsonwebtoken input-bearing diagnostics through ?. Invalid trusted issuance/configuration/signing failures use fixed static InvalidStoredData messages without raw error/input values. Correctly signed fixtures prove grammar/crypto only.
caller_responsibilities: Both Current and Expired require the later owner to load ACTIVE Account/current generation/Account-family protocol ownership/revocation/absolute lifetime. Expired alone permits no downgrade: caller must refuse invalid current generation/state/family before any CSRF refresh-only fallback. Non-expiry validation error never triggers fallback. Actual primary WebAuthn, browser nonce/cookie binding and matching proof sub/sid/generation remain separate owners.
No live production login, credential mint or new transport is authorized by this private test artifact.
next_tests: Append account_crypto module to already-registered auth/tests/jwt_es256.rs, using existing ephemeral es256_material helper. Import remains blocked until root freezes exact API. Protocol-separation3 current-API tests proceed independently first.

supersedes.reason: Keep existing AuthError with only sanitized fixed outcomes; avoid extra public error enum after Capture minimal-API clarification. Preserve exact approved nbf<=exp bound.

error_contract: No new public error type. Access expiry is only AccountAccessVerification::Expired after all other checks; CSRF expiry is fixed ExpiredSignature. Both fixed JWT unit errors and static issuance errors have safe Debug/Display. Exact prose of static errors is an implementation choice; retaining diagnostic sources or caller strings is forbidden.
